users_type_chk.name: users_type_chk
users_type_chk.value: (user_type = 'platform' AND vendor_id IS NULL) OR (user_type = 'vendor' AND vendor_id IS NOT NULL)

product_variants_vendor_barcode_uq.name: product_variants_vendor_barcode_uq
product_variants_vendor_barcode_uq.where: "product_variants"."barcode" IS NOT NULL AND "product_variants"."deleted_at" IS NULL

product_variants_price_chk.name: product_variants_price_chk
product_variants_price_chk.value: (mrp_minor IS NULL OR mrp_minor >= 0) AND (selling_price_minor IS NULL OR selling_price_minor >= 0)

marketplace_listings_override_chk.name: marketplace_listings_override_chk
marketplace_listings_override_chk.value: (buffer_override IS NULL OR buffer_override >= 0) AND (max_quantity_override IS NULL OR max_quantity_override >= 0)

inventory_qty_chk.name: inventory_qty_chk
inventory_qty_chk.value: quantity_on_hand >= 0 AND quantity_reserved >= 0 AND quantity_reserved <= quantity_on_hand AND quantity_incoming >= 0 AND quantity_damaged >= 0 AND quantity_returned >= 0

order_items_qty_chk.name: order_items_qty_chk
order_items_qty_chk.value: quantity > 0 AND reserved_quantity >= 0 AND reserved_quantity <= quantity

attribute_mappings_shape_chk.name: attribute_mappings_shape_chk
attribute_mappings_shape_chk.value: (source_type = 'core_field' AND core_field IS NOT NULL) OR (source_type = 'attribute' AND attribute_id IS NOT NULL) OR (source_type = 'static' AND static_value IS NOT NULL)

channel_inventory_policies_range_chk.name: channel_inventory_policies_range_chk
channel_inventory_policies_range_chk.value: safety_buffer >= 0 AND allocation_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND (max_quantity IS NULL OR max_quantity >= 0)

inventory_movements_nonzero_chk.name: inventory_movements_nonzero_chk
inventory_movements_nonzero_chk.value: delta_on_hand <> 0 OR delta_reserved <> 0 OR delta_incoming <> 0 OR delta_damaged <> 0 OR delta_returned <> 0

stock_transfer_items_qty_chk.name: stock_transfer_items_qty_chk
stock_transfer_items_qty_chk.value: quantity > 0 AND received_quantity >= 0 AND received_quantity <= quantity
